li.label: A friendly contest: their Pokémon against ours, as a show
li.tip: {A_nameDef}'s Pokémon against the trainers' best, at their fire this afternoon or evening, with whoever wants to watch. Nobody is hurt; the higher level is likelier to win, never surely. They remember it, and so does the colony, if they come back.

outcomes.li: {X_nameDef} grinned and whistled {X_possessive} Pokémon over. The show is set for their fire, and half the colony means to watch.
[rematch] {X_nameDef} said {X_pronoun} had been waiting a season for this. The rematch is set for their fire.
[rematch,beatUs] "Same as last time," {X_nameDef} said, "I win." The rematch is set for their fire, and {A_nameDef} has something to prove.
[rematch,beatThem] {X_nameDef} has not forgotten losing last time, and says so. The rematch is set for their fire.

li.label: Ask them about training
li.tip: {A_nameDef} spends a while at the trainers' fire talking Pokémon: moves, levels, what to feed them. Practice with animals.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} sat at the trainers' fire until dark, asking questions. {X_nameDef} answered every one, and asked a few back.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {X_pronoun} works with {X_possessive} Pokémon, and {A_nameDef} came back with a head full of it.

li.label: talking training at the trainers' fire

texts.li: Two or three trainers of {FACTION} have made camp {PLACE}, their Pokémon at their heels and a ball or two at every belt. {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} for leave to stay a few days, and whether the colony had any Pokémon of its own to show.

{X_nameDef} and the other trainers of {FACTION} have pitched camp {PLACE}, and their Pokémon are already chasing each other round the fire. They trade, {X_nameDef} says, and they'd welcome a friendly contest.

settled.li: The trainers' camp {PLACE} has its fire going and the Pokémon curled up around it in a ring, each by its own trainer.
Smoke rises from the trainers' camp {PLACE}, and now and then a Pokémon's cry. They're practising.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, one of the trainers camped {PLACE}, came to the gate with {X_possessive} Pokémon and a question: would the colony have a trainer and a partner, for good?

farewell.li: The trainers of {FACTION} have struck their camp {PLACE} and gone on down the road, their Pokémon trotting behind. {X_nameDef} said they'd be back for a rematch.
The trainers' camp {PLACE} is empty this morning. They left early, {X_nameDef} said, to be at the next town by market day.
